tasks.title: Create user profile page component
tasks.description: Create a React component for user profile page with username, email, and avatar display. Use TypeScript and include proper prop types.
tasks.context: Part of the user management feature. Should follow our component structure standards.

tasks.title: Add authentication middleware
tasks.description: Implement JWT authentication middleware for Express routes. Include token validation, error handling, and user context attachment.
tasks.context: Security critical - ensure proper validation and error messages.

tasks.title: Design database schema for user settings
tasks.description: Create a database migration file for user settings table. Include fields for theme preference, notification settings, and privacy options.
tasks.context: PostgreSQL database. Use best practices for nullable fields and defaults.

tasks.title: Create API endpoint for user profile updates
tasks.description: Build a PUT endpoint at /api/users/:id that allows updating user profile information. Include validation, error handling, and proper status codes.
tasks.context: Should integrate with the UserProfile component from task-001.

tasks.title: Add unit tests for authentication flow
tasks.description: Write comprehensive unit tests for the authentication middleware using Jest. Cover success cases, invalid tokens, expired tokens, and missing tokens.
tasks.context: Depends on the auth middleware from task-002 being completed.
